entries.t: <FACE:03>Never seen a Medabot<NL>like this… stag type?<WAIT>But… completely unlike<NL>anything so far!
<FACE:11>That «Sonic Stag» is<NL>our RR Company's best<WAIT>It's still just a<NL>prototype, though<WAIT><FACE:03>Wow, amazing<NL><WAIT>To think I get to see<NL>a Medabot like that
<FACE:0F>Did I say that?<NL>Do pay it no mind
<FACE:0F>…Anyway<NL><WAIT>I showed it to you for<NL>one reason only<WAIT>You've been chosen to<NL>test that prototype

<FACE:11>Of course it is<NL><WAIT>RR was after a tester<NL>among Medafighters<WAIT>You and I met by a<NL>wonderful chance<WAIT>But I won't let it end<NL>as mere chance<WAIT>So I recommended you<NL>myself
<FACE:00>(With this Medabot…)<WAIT>(Maybe even I could<NL>climb the rankings)<WAIT>(And then maybe Hiyori<NL>wouldn't mock me)
<FACE:04>…Huh?<NL><WAIT>Come to think of it,<NL>where'd Hiyori go?
<FACE:0F>No need to panic,<NL><PLAYER>…<WAIT>We have plenty of<NL>time
<FACE:0F>I want to make a deal…<NL>My side of it is<WAIT>that «Sonic Stag»
<FACE:03>What are you talking<NL>about, Shiden!?<WAIT><FACE:0F>Your side is what<NL>happened in the cave…
<FACE:04>(I knew it…)<NL><WAIT>(He means the Medal I<NL>found in that cave…?)
<FACE:10>Now talk!<NL><WAIT>What did you hear from<NL>that Medabot!<WAIT>Just what was it that<NL>you heard!?

<FACE:01>What do you mean!<NL><WAIT>I don't get a word<NL>you're saying!!<WAIT>Locking me up in here…<NL>what are you after!?<WAIT><FACE:10>Play dumb all you like<NL>I already know<WAIT>That word only you<NL>heard… «Mistral»…<WAIT>A word I could not<NL>hear myself…<WAIT>You'll tell me it all<NL>
<FACE:0F>Now! The first test<NL>of the prototype!<WAIT>I'll have my fun until<NL>you confess it all

<FACE:04>(My Medal…<NL>they still have it!)<WAIT>(What do I do…?)<WAIT><FACE:0F>Hahaha! Do hurry<NL>Those are custom-made<WAIT>They see any intruder<NL>as an enemy now<WAIT>I adjusted their «3<NL>Laws of Medabots»
<FACE:04>(All I've got is the<NL>one from that cave…)
<FACE:0F>Well, never mind…<NL><WAIT>I'll get your secret<NL>out of you for sure<WAIT>And it doubles as the<NL>prototype test…<WAIT>By the time I get back<NL>you'll be obedient…
<FACE:01>(I can't take on all<NL>of them at once!)<WAIT>(No matter how strong<NL>this one is…!)
<FACE:01><MEDABOT>!<NL>Aim for that spot!<WAIT>It's the only way out<NL>for us!
<FACE:0F>(Heh heh heh…)<NL><WAIT>(That should keep him<NL>in there a while…)
<FACE:05>We won somehow, but<NL>where'd that boy go…
